scripts.check: npm run check:sdk && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy:mvp: echo 'vetnotes.me is SSR now — hosting rewrites ** to Cloud Run vetnotes-cpd-ssr. Use deploy:ssr (app) or deploy:ssr-hosting (rewrite config).' && exit 1
scripts.deploy:ssr: npm run predeploy:check && gcloud run deploy vetnotes-cpd-ssr --source . --region australia-southeast1 --project vetnotes-mvp --allow-unauthenticated --memory 512Mi --port 8080 --update-env-vars GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=vetsorcery --quiet
scripts.deploy:pro: npm run build && firebase deploy -P pro --only hosting:production
scripts.deploy:vetcpd: echo 'REMOVED: the vetcpd hosting site is owned by apps/vetcpd-academy (a different repo AND Firebase project). Running this published this repo stale vetcpd-dist/ over the live CPD Academy. Deploy from vetcpd-academy instead.' && exit 1
